findings.title: Express.js Open Redirect in malformed URLs
findings.description: OSV-Scanner reported a known vulnerability for a dependency in a recognized manifest or lockfile.
findings.evidence: express@4.18.2 is affected by GHSA-rv95-896h-c2vc, CVE-2024-29041.
findings.remediation: Upgrade express to a fixed version: 4.19.2, 5.0.0-beta.3.

findings.title: Express.js Open Redirect in malformed URLs
findings.description: PMG wrapped npm audit reported a known npm dependency vulnerability without installing packages.
findings.remediation: Upgrade express to 4.22.2 after dependency review.

findings.title: HTML response may include unsanitized input
findings.description: Hermsec's offline heuristic scanner found a risky source pattern.
findings.remediation: Escape untrusted output before placing it in HTML responses.
